$$

		\dfrac {2\left(\sqrt 3 + 1\right)} {3 - 1} &= \[5pt]		
		\dfrac {2\left(\sqrt 3 + 1\right)} {2} &= \[5pt]	
		\sqrt 3 + 1 &
	}
$$
